name: Every Sub-Ten Dismantlable-Ample Interval Has a First Concept
statement: If $C\subsetneq H$ are dismantlable ample and $|H\setminus C|\le9$, then some $h\in H\setminus C$ satisfies $C\cup\{h\}\in\mathsf{Damp}$.
proof: Otherwise choose a dismantlable-ample $J$ inclusion-minimal with $C\subsetneq J\subseteq H$. No corner of $J$ can lie outside $C$: deleting such a corner either gives the forbidden first extension of $C$ or contradicts minimality of $J$. Hence $\operatorname{Cor}(J)\subseteq C$ and $1\le|J\setminus C|\le9$, producing a trapped pair below the established bound $\rho_{\mathsf{Damp}}\ge10$.
